t: Titan medium version 93mm Delta sander backing pad measures 93mm and restores worn hook and loop surfaces on delta sanders to improve disc retention and sanding efficiency. The replacement pad is suitable for trade professionals and DIYers undertaking detailed woodwork restoration or corner sanding in kitchens and bathrooms. Constructed from durable ethylene-vinyl acetate foam and polypropylene, the universal fit pad offers reliable cushioning and a secure attachment. Installation is simple, requiring users to sand down old hooks, clean the surface, and apply the new self-adhesive pad, quickly returning orbital sanders to peak performance.
